title: Pokecentral
description: Pokecentral is one of the longest-running Pokémon Minecraft servers!
body:
Pokecentral is one of the longest-running Pokémon Minecraft servers! Over our 10+ years of operation, we have provided players with a wide range of features and a caring, helpful community.

Features
- Raids
- Battle Tower
- Clue Scrolls
- Poke Hunts
- Daycare
- Server Poke Hunts
- Daily Login
- 30 unique achievements
- Achievement Leaderboards
- 100+ Custom Texture Pokemon
- Vote Parties
- Player ran chest shops
- Player Warps
- Bosses
- Boss Blitz
- Poke Chests
- Legendary Exchange
- Trainers
- Mega Stones
- Pokemon Trivia
- Kits
- Poke Casino
- Better PC
- Private Legendary Spawns
- Keys and Eggs
- Group Chats
- EV Training Zone
- Pokedesigner
- Safe Trade
- GTS
- Server Shop 
- Wonder Trade
- Pokemon Spawning Wiki

Events
- Tournaments (Seasonal Prize is PayPal)
- Build Contests (Rewards Store Credit)
- Texture Making Contests (Rewards Store Credit)
- Seasonal Events
- Frequent Giveaways
- Boosters
